# Tactura

> Tactura turns photos and artwork into 3D-printable reliefs on iPhone and iPad.

The app processes photos on the device and exports STL files and PNG height maps.
The browser demo lets you preview a 2.5D relief from your own photo and adjust its depth with one slider.
It fits the image within 1000 × 1000 pixels. File export is available in the app.

## Product and demo

- [Tactura homepage](https://www.tactura.app/): Features and a real 3D print example.
- [Browser demo](https://www.tactura.app/demo): Try a relief preview with your own photo.
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6802478241): Download Tactura for iPhone and iPad.

## Support

- [Privacy policy](https://www.tactura.app/privacy): How Tactura handles photos and data.
- [Contact](https://www.tactura.app/contact): Get help with Tactura.
